# Untold.works

> The portfolio of Joshua Semolik. I work where product, strategy and storytelling meet, and I build the system that keeps the story running.

Joshua Semolik: almost three decades in brand, product and marketing. Storytelling first, AI as the crew. Brand, product and marketing since 1999. Built with AI since 2024. Today Creative Director at Billiard Factory. Based in Houston, working in English and Spanish.

## Pages

- [Home](https://untold.works/): Storytelling is the craft. AI is the crew. The four categories of work and the support system behind a story.
- [Platforms](https://untold.works/platforms): The systems a company runs on so the story keeps going out: the plan, the publishing, the operations, and one place where every team works.
- [Brand and product](https://untold.works/brand-and-product): The rules that keep a company sounding like itself, and the things people buy, down to the room they buy them in.
- [Websites](https://untold.works/websites): Sites for artists, retailers, a food tech company, a trade showroom, a hotel and a café, each one built around the story it has to tell.
- [Campaigns](https://untold.works/campaigns): Seasons, events, films and the pages that catch the lead, planned on one calendar and shipped through the engine.
- [Landing pages](https://untold.works/work/landing-pages): Ten campaign pages for Billiard Factory, each one taken from the idea to the lead.
- [Robert Glasper and Blue Note](https://untold.works/work/robert-glasper-blue-note): Eight years telling the story around one artist: his records, his residency, his clubs and his festival.
- [Elena Pinderhughes](https://untold.works/work/elena-pinderhughes): The debut album site for I Hope You Feel It Too.
- [About](https://untold.works/about): Bio, clients since 2024, career 1999 to 2023, earlier film work, education.

## Work

### 01. Platforms (7 projects)

The engine behind the story. The systems a company runs on so the story keeps going out: the plan, the publishing, the operations, and one place where every team works.

- Engine Room. Client: Billiard Factory; What it is: Marketing and operations platform; Specs: 38 pages · 57 functions · 1,830 tests; Built with: Claude Code.
- Content Factory. Client: Billiard Factory; Runs: A post and a story every day; Credit: Designed and directed; Built by: Brady Stick.
- C.L. Bailey portal and concierge. Client: C.L. Bailey; Dealer portal: About 70 dealers; Site: Bilingual, AI concierge, dealer locator; Status: Live ↗ (https://clbailey.com).
- Off STORIS. Client: Billiard Factory · 12 showrooms; Storefront: Shopify, began Oct 1, 2026; ERP: XoroERP, signed Sep 30, 2026; Status: In progress.
- OMI lead intake. Client: OMI Growth; What it is: Lead intake and routing; Connected to: The CRM; Years: 2024–2025.
- Casa Schuck ops dashboard. Client: Casa Schuck; What it is: Hotel operations dashboard; Status: Full demo, no live data yet.
- Sante Peptides. Client: Sante Peptides; Stack: Anthropic SDK · Postgres · auth; Languages: English and Spanish; Date: May 2026.
